summary: Fix GitHub Pages blank screen by switching build_type to workflow, configuring base path, and adding .nojekyll
details: Diagnosed blank screen on https://ahmadibrahim4geo.github.io/MDAR/. Root cause was repository Pages build_type set to legacy (deploying raw root index.html with unbundled TSX via Jekyll). Updated repository Pages build_type to workflow via GitHub REST API; updated .github/workflows/deploy.yml with configure-pages output and workflow_dispatch; updated vite.config.ts to support dynamic VITE_BASE_PATH; added public/.nojekyll and public/404.html.
